name: Warlock
lore: Dark summoner of the Twisting Nether: sacrifice your own vitality for endless power, harvest Soul Shards, and command demonic minions.

resource.name: Soul Shards
resource.tip: Harvest Soul Shards from dying foes and Drain Soul. Spend Shards on demonic summons, healthstones, and catastrophic curses.
resource.rules: Harvest Soul Shards from fallen enemies to summon demonic guardians and unleash high-cost curses. Use Life Tap to convert your health directly into Energy.

archetypes.name: Affliction
archetypes.text: Stack Poison, Curses and drains; Curse of Doom ends long fights.

archetypes.name: Demonology
archetypes.text: Summon and feed your demon, link damage to it, and ritual-summon Infernals and Doomguards.

archetypes.name: Destruction
archetypes.text: Burn damage: Immolate into Conflagrate, Shadowburn finishers and AoE fire.

relics.name: Nemesis Skullcap
relics.text: Start each combat with 2 Soul Shards. Gain 1 energy next turn whenever you summon.

relics.name: Robes of Volatile Power
relics.text: Start each combat with 1 Strength. Whenever you lose HP to your own cards, gain 3 Block.
